sermon.title: God’s Rest - June 23, 2024
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: Part one of God’s rest: God calls us to go to His land, a kingdom of freedom with its own laws. We enter by Jesus the door and keep His commandments, all about loving God and neighbor. We enter His presence God’s way, and He gives rest from our enemies, Satan, wicked influences and even family opposition, if we don’t look back.
